decided_by: PI, 2026-09-28: finish 2v2 completely -- Share-Encoder, then Fully Shared+z, then Generalist, then the three deployment-noise cases -- before touching 4v4 or 6v6.
scope: 2v2 only. Authorizes the three distillation runs below and reserves their evaluation block; the evaluation itself is frozen separately once the three students are frozen.
THE_QUESTION: On one frozen 2v2 teacher-state set, with the same teachers, objective and budget, how much of the Separated system's specialization survives when the strategies share an encoder (Share-Encoder), share the whole network with a strategy ID (Fully Shared+z), or share the whole network with no strategy ID (Generalist)?
ARM_ORDER_rule: an arm may launch only after every earlier arm has written STUDENT_FROZEN.json; preflight is exempt

DATASET_locked.content_sha256_definition: sha256 of the sorted lines '<shard file>\t<sha256 of shard bytes>' over every shard the manifest lists
DATASET_locked.audit_required: GREEN on disk AND a live re-run of this dataset's per-scale audit (audit_one) passes every check at preflight

POLES_locked.must_equal: the dataset manifest's poles AND a fresh resolution through experiments/pole_attestation.py (checked by the live audit)

RECIPE_locked.parameters_trained: actor only; critic frozen (requires_grad False, no gradient, not stepped)
RECIPE_locked.fit_floor: holdout agreement >= 0.50 on both z (status FIT_FAILED otherwise; the student is still frozen and reported)

SPLIT_AND_SAMPLING_locked.holdout: episode % 10 == 9, per pole (episodes 9,19,...,89 of each pole)
SPLIT_AND_SAMPLING_locked.sampling: every batch half Pole A rows, half Pole B rows (run_teacher_distillation.Batches), permutation seeded by the arm's training seed

share_encoder.label: Share-Encoder
share_encoder.shared: actor_cnn only, tied by module identity
share_encoder.branch_arch: the specialists' own architecture (from KL teacher pi_A)
share_encoder.init: fresh; branch z0 under seed 24200001, branch z1 under 24200002

fully_shared.label: Fully Shared+z
fully_shared.architecture: one SharedActorCentralizedCritic, specialist trunk, latent_k=2, concat z embedding d_z=16; no private trunks, no per-z heads, no FiLM, no router

generalist.label: Generalist
generalist.architecture: the specialist architecture, latent_k=0, no z pathway

evaluation.why_one_block: matched seeds within the scale (CROSS_SCALE_CANONICAL_RECIPE_V1 evaluation.matched_seeds_within_scale): every arm, and the Separated reference for Delta_G, is scored on the same 128 seeds
evaluation.separated_ref_note: the Separated run on this block exists only to pair Delta_G (GENERALIST_DEFINITION_V1#SCORING_locked); the 2v2 main Separated value stays the fresh confirmatory +0.117/+0.539

SEEDS_locked.all_must_be: registered in artifacts/SEED_REGISTRY.json and RESERVED at preflight

EVALUATION_planned.sharing_arms: forced z, no router, deterministic; Delta_A = V(z0,A) - V(z1,A), Delta_B = V(z1,B) - V(z0,B)
EVALUATION_planned.frozen_later_in: STANDARDIZED_2V2_SHARING_EVAL_SPEC.json, after the three students are frozen and their checkpoint sha256s can be pinned

OUTPUTS.why_a_new_root: suite_sharing/2v2/fully_shared_z holds a student distilled from the legacy 2v2 dataset; it stays as provenance and is never overwritten or reused

FORBIDDEN_INPUTS: any student or result under artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/suite_sharing/ (legacy-dataset 2v2 and invalidated 4v4)
PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED: this spec FROZEN; the arm is in ARM_ORDER
dataset manifest sha256 and content sha256 equal the pins; status FROZEN_DATASET
audit record GREEN and live re-audit of this dataset passes every check (pole identities vs certification, teacher pins, shards, k=1, N=2)
teacher checkpoints on disk equal TEACHERS_locked and the manifest's teachers
scientific tree clean (experiments/ rl/ gpu_env/ configs/ root *.py)
the arm's training block and the evaluation block registered and RESERVED
recipe constants in the runner equal RECIPE_locked
no forbidden input is read (dataset path resolves to DATASET_locked.manifest)

architecture checks per arm (existing): shared/private identity + arithmetic, z changes logits (sharing arms) / z has no pathway (generalist), fresh init, teacher self-KL 0, finite positive loss, gradient on actor only, round-trip
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: changing the dataset, teachers, recipe, split or arm order
